name: smwgraphics-mumbo-jumbo
title: Mumbo Jumbo
description:
I made this for funsies

This is Mumbo, he's a famous minecrafter known for doing redstone. He turns red once he collects a fireflower, and he gains an elytra-colored cape when he collects a feather. Player 2's name is Jumbo, who wears a green tie akin to Luigi.

Why use this character in your hack? Well actually... you'd be surprised. ;)
